title: Impact on Singapore's Digital Ecosystem following Meta's Decision to Eliminate Fact-checking and Reduce Content Moderation Effort
what_it_is: Impact on Singapore's Digital Ecosystem following Meta's Decision to Eliminate Fact-checking and Reduce Content Moderation Effort

sections.label: Fact-checking as first defence
sections.summary: A reliable fact-checking and content moderation system acts as a first line of defence against misinformation, and Meta has significant reach in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: A reliable fact-checking and content moderation system on social media platforms, therefore, serves as a crucial first line of defence against misinformation and harmful online content, allowing platforms to act early to detect, correct or filter out such material.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Meta has been assessed to be a social media platform with significant reach in Singapore.

sections.label: CATOS funding and Trust by Design
sections.summary: Singapore committed $50 million over five years to CATOS, which tests Trust by Design technologies like watermarking and content authentication.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: In May last year, we committed $50 million in funding over five years to the Centre for Advanced Technologies in Online Safety (CATOS), which will bring together government, industry, academics and civil society, to develop and deploy technological solutions to build a safer online ecosystem for Singapore users.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Part of CATOS' work includes testing "Trust by Design" technologies, such as watermarking and content authentication, so as to enhance the authenticity of digital content.

sections.label: Meta policy and election advertising Bill
sections.summary: The government is in touch with Meta over its policy, will assess regulatory concerns, and passed the Elections (Integrity of Online Advertising) (Amendment) Bill.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: With regards to this particular instance, we are in touch with Meta and we are working with them to understand the specifics and details of this policy and the implications to the US, as well as to the global larger population.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We will continue to assess if there are areas of concerns and if there are areas where we need to enhance our regulations, to see if they will continue to meet their obligations under our existing regulations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Two, I would also highlight that we have always been on the lookout for all the new trends and developments, especially during sensitive periods like the election, which is why the Elections (Integrity of Online Advertising) (Amendment) Bill was passed recently, specifically looking into the integrity of information online during the election period.

sections.label: Safeguards for safe online space
sections.summary: Safeguards ensure platforms share the outcomes of a safe online space and high integrity of content.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, we are looking into some of these.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But as a start, our safeguards make sure that the platforms are on the same page, with regard to the outcomes we want to achieve, that there is a safe online space and there is a high integrity of the content that is put out.
